payout_quote: Terms and Conditions Applicable to the $1,500 Bonus Commercial Checking Account Offer. Offer Period: This promotional offer is valid from 09/07/2026 through 11/24/2026. Eligibility: Membership required. Offer available to new and existing business members who do not currently have an HVFCU business checking account. Must reside or operate a business in Albany, Columbia, Dutchess, Greene, Orange, Putnam, Rensselaer, Rockland, Saratoga, Schenectady, Sullivan, Ulster, or Westchester County in New York State. How to Earn the Bonus: 1. Open a New Account: Open your first new HVFCU Enhanced Business Checking Account during the promotional period. 2. Meet Deposit and Balance Requirements: Make or receive qualifying deposit(s) of at least $7,500. Maintain the required average balance through the end of the third full calendar month after the account opening. 3. Complete Qualifying Transactions: Complete ten (10) qualifying transactions within ninety (90) days of enrollment. 4. Enroll in Online Banking: Sign up for Internet or Mobile Banking. Fulfillment: HVFCU will deposit the cash bonus into the account holder's new checking account thirty (30) days after meeting requirements. Cash bonuses may be reported to the Internal Revenue Service as interest or miscellaneous income (Form 1099-INT or 1099-MISC, as applicable).

steps: Open your first new HVCU Enhanced Business Checking account in-branch or online during the offer period (09/07/2026-11/24/2026); you must reside or operate a business in one of the 14 eligible NY counties.
Make or receive qualifying deposits totaling at least $7,500.
Maintain the required average balance through the end of the third full calendar month after account opening.
Complete 10 qualifying transactions (deposits, ACH credits, incoming wires, bill pay, debit card purchases) within 90 days of enrollment.
Enroll in HVCU Internet or Mobile Banking.
Receive the $1,500 bonus in the business checking account 30 days after all requirements are met and verified; keep the account open and in good standing.
